## Checklist

- [ ] One change per commit, with [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) messages
- [ ] An entry under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` if users will notice the change
- [ ] README, SETUP or SECURITY updated if the change needs it
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` (pedantic), `cargo test` and `scripts/bump-version.sh --check` pass, as listed in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] No API keys, `secrets.env` contents or personal paths anywhere in the diff
